log.detail: Dance when the music plays. When it stops — freeze like the animal I show you! Ready?
one per gap: Dance, dance, dance!
over 6 words: A tiny wobble, but you held the flamingo!
one per gap: The music tricked you!
over 6 words: A tiny wobble, but you held the frog!
Great round! Your best freeze was the flamingo.
One more round? I am ready when you are.
